About
Who I Am

Where science meets
the written word

I am a multilingual writer and professional with an unusual combination: a Bachelor's in Environmental Engineering from Baku State University and a Master's in Human Resource Management from UNEC, with a thesis focused on Artificial Intelligence in HR.

This interdisciplinary background gives my writing a distinct voice — analytical yet human, grounded in data yet emotionally resonant. I write in Azerbaijani, Turkish, and English, adapting seamlessly across tones, audiences, and formats.

Whether crafting a philosophical essay, an ESG sustainability report, a brand content strategy, or annotating AI training data — I bring the same commitment: precision, clarity, and depth.
